System blueprint

An assistant grounded in approved knowledge

Help people find and apply approved information with a retrieval-based assistant. Define document ownership and access, provide source context, evaluate representative questions, and give unsupported cases a clear route to a person.

Level 2Choose a capability

A conversational answer can sound certain even when the source is missing, stale, conflicting, or restricted. A useful assistant needs a controlled knowledge boundary, appropriate permissions, evidence-linked answers, and a maintenance and escalation process.

Useful outputs

  • A knowledge inventory with ownership, permissions, freshness, and indexing boundaries.
  • A retrieval and answer interface with source context and escalation rules.
  • A representative evaluation set and documented quality review.
  • A maintenance, operator, and recovery handover.

Inputs we need

  • Approved documents, source owners, update dates, and audience permissions.
  • Representative questions, acceptable answer criteria, and excluded topics or actions.
  • Model and retrieval access, hosting expectations, and human escalation ownership.
Level 3Explore a focus

Prepare the knowledge boundary

Inventory approved material, owners, update dates, access rules, and excluded content. Define representative questions and the situations the assistant should not answer.

  • Flag insufficient, conflicting, stale, or unsupported evidence instead of inventing an answer.
  • Send unsupported questions and operational failures to the agreed human queue.
  • Approve indexing boundaries, document rights, and organization or user permissions.
  • Evaluate source accuracy, citation support, usefulness, and uncertainty behaviour.
  • Review knowledge updates and changed model behaviour before wider release.

Build constrained assistance

Implement the selected indexing, retrieval, and model workflow with relevant metadata and access checks. Require source context and clear uncertainty handling for the agreed task.

  • An evaluation record and maintenance runbook with named ownership.

Human expertise

Own the judgment.

Knowledge owners approve material and access. Experts evaluate answer quality and manage conflicting information; operators handle escalation and maintain the accepted knowledge and workflow.

AI assistance

Support the process.

AI retrieves and prepares candidate answers from approved evidence. It should identify insufficient support and avoid presenting an inference as a verified fact or taking an unsupported action.
